estimate_assumptions: Conditional planning estimate from three steady optimizer samples and two full validation/checkpoint writes at this exact pilot shape; 2x time buffer and 25% reserved-memory margin rounded up to0.25GiB. finite_stopping_condition: Exactly 360 optimizer steps (three passes); second and final permitted scope revision. No automatic retry, extension or final-test tuning.
initialization: Same pinned pretrained DistilBERT, seed, reviewed raw rows, labels, optimizer, learning rate, token shape and finite cap as revision 1; only the versioned classifier input adaptation changes. No continuation of prior weights.
limitations: Automated development review is disclosed and cannot establish independent human label quality.
Only six entity families and twelve shared question forms; no final-test or unrestricted-language claim.
